directive.quote: Every engine job of the old Worker's rust-engine backlog rows works on the new engine, one to one or better.

preserve: a bounded list (items_per_request 500) of exact absolute paths, each with retire true and a 1f: expected identity, each named once, or the whole call is refused
a name that now names another identity, or a folder, is a conflict and nothing changes
an existing name is set aside and forgotten at once, so its file is noted for the byte release, which keeps the bytes while any other name holds them
a name already gone is answered as repeated and writes nothing
allowed_deltas: the set-aside state with no due date and forgetNow become the set_aside carry and forget_set_aside, since the Rust set-aside has no states
the old single transaction is two resumable steps: a stop between them leaves the name set aside with the expected file, and the repeat forgets it
a refused set-aside (the name changed or is still uploading) answers the old refusal words
banned_substitutions: retiring a name by prefix or folder
retiring a name whose identity is not compared
erasing another alias of the file
